findings.text: Public tracking service exposes separate map, unmap and sync helpers for single, physical, scatter gather and coherent operations plus a mapping error marker. All helpers silently skip work while the global disabled flag is set and otherwise record new entries or validate references against stored state.
Bus integration helper registers a device unbind observer for a caller supplied bus unless debugging is disabled. Allocation failure is reported and aborts registration without side effects.

Early filesystem setup creates a dedicated directory for DMA API debugging and populates read only status counters, read write control counters and two custom files for driver filtering and state dumping.

Startup initialization guarantees prepared bucket lists and locks with a configured entry pool when enabled, latched disable when preallocation wholly fails, and recorded low water mark plus enabled flag on success, with diagnostics for each outcome.
Boot command handlers provide an off switch that latches global disable and a size control that parses a requested preallocation count with a built in fallback when parsing yields nothing.

Bus notifier reacts only to driver unbind events while enabled, counts outstanding allocations for the affected device and emits a diagnostic naming count, device address, size, direction and mapping kind when any remain.
Access to the current filter name and cached driver pointer serializes on a dedicated read write lock held with interrupts disabled, shared mode for readers and exclusive mode for writers.

Tracking hash uses one spin lock per bucket held with interrupts disabled across lookup, enumeration and removal. Callers release the bucket before invoking mapping error checks or freeing entries to avoid nested lock ordering hazards.
Driver filter file binds read, write and seek handlers to custom filter logic for reads and writes and to the generic seek helper for positioning.

Tracking records observed in these fragments carry owning device, mapping kind, CPU side address, device side address, length, transfer direction, call and mapped scatter counts, attribute flags and a map error checked marker.

Filter read reports empty output when no filter name is set. Otherwise it returns a newline terminated copy produced under shared lock into a bounded temporary buffer and served through the generic buffered read helper.

Filter write accepts up to a bounded prefix of user input, treats a leading non alphanumeric as a request to clear the filter, otherwise retains only the first whitespace delimited token as the new filter name, clears any cached driver association, and reports full input length on success.

Unmap validation coverage includes exact match requirement with diagnostics for length, kind, CPU address on coherent kinds, scatter count on scatter kind, direction, checked state and masked attributes, with removal of the stored entry regardless of mismatch outcome.

Sync validation coverage includes containment within a stored allocation with diagnostics for range overflow, direction compatibility with bidirectional mappings exempt, CPU versus device direction misuse in each direction, and scatter count consistency.

Map time source validation includes diagnostics for invalid addresses, virtual allocation area usage, task stack occupancy for direct and virtual stacks, overlap with kernel text or read only data, RAM misuse for resource mappings, and segment size or boundary violations for scatter lists.

Scatter unmap and sync iteration bounds derive from the stored mapped count of the first element, stopping before that bound to tolerate coalescing where fewer device segments exist than input entries.

Coherent handling is defined for linear and virtual allocation addresses with null or invalid inputs ignored, CPU pointer translated to physical form for storage or comparison, and direction fixed to bidirectional.

Physical mappings start life marked unchecked. An explicit mapping error hook promotes the first matching unchecked record to checked using best fit to tolerate duplicate device addresses, and later unmap warns if the record is still unchecked.

Debugging remains disabled when forced off or when entry preallocation wholly fails, otherwise becomes initialized after buckets and entries are ready. Every fast path tests the disabled predicate first and the unbind observer and bus registration honor it as well.

Driver filter toggles between cleared and named states. Clearing zeroes the name and drops the cached driver, while naming installs a truncated token and likewise drops the cached driver for later resolution.

User buffers are never accessed while holding the filter lock because faulting copies may sleep while the lock disables interrupts. Both directions stage through bounded kernel temporaries outside the critical section.
Bucket locks are dropped before error path helpers and before entry reclamation to prevent ordering cycles with other allocator or mapping subsystems.

DMA API debug directory named dma-api exposes disabled and error_count and all_errors and num_errors and num_free_entries and min_free_entries and nr_total_entries plus driver_filter and dump. Status and dump use 0444 while controls and driver_filter use 0644.

Unmap attribute comparison masks to six members, namely DMA_ATTR_NO_KERNEL_MAPPING and DMA_ATTR_FORCE_CONTIGUOUS and DMA_ATTR_MMIO and DMA_ATTR_REQUIRE_COHERENT and DMA_ATTR_PRIVILEGED and DMA_ATTR_CC_SHARED, permitting other flags to differ.
